item.subject: maths
item.stem:
Tushar looks at the diagram of an irregular closed shape drawn on $1\,\mathrm{cm}^{2}$ squared paper.

Which claim correctly estimates the area of the shape?

options.A: Count the square centimetres the shape covers on the grid, combining full squares with estimated parts of squares.
options.B: Report the words squared paper as the area of the shape.
options.C: The area estimate produces the squared-paper grid, so draw the grid after naming an area.
options.D: Find the perimeter of the shape in centimetres and treat that length as the area.
